notes: Random XMIDI images: a FORM header (usually with the right size, otherwise shorter) followed by up to six chunks (TIMB with 0..40 entries, RBRN, EVNT, near-miss tags, sizes with high bits) in random bytes; a null sequence in 5% of cases. 0x111f84 logs its arguments and returns the image or (8%) 0. The driver state's timbre callback (+0x1a4, absent in 20%) logs its three arguments and returns per-case answers (never, sometimes or always nonzero). 0x112bbc, 0x111df0, 0x101f88 and 0xa4342 log their arguments; 0x101f88 returns AX..DX through its register block. All stubs clobber EBX/ECX/EDX like the originals. 0x17d7b6 (read by 0x102020) is mostly 0. The byte swap, the tag compare and memmove run as originals (needs --flat-segments). The sequence record, the driver state, its buffer, the TIMB copy and the AIL error buffer are compared as RAM.
